response.sql: WITH site_groups AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing AS sp JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), group_means AS (SELECT site_groups.*, AVG(avg_remaining_storage) OVER () AS mean_group_storage FROM site_groups) SELECT site_code, insurance_status, avg_remaining_storage, avg_cpu_gpu_gap, avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(mean_group_storage, 0) AS storage_ratio FROM group_means WHERE mean_group_storage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
